reconstruction.heightBasis: No retained or current map heights exist. Visualization estimates: cubic hall roof/parapet 33.5 m; three dark bands at 27.6, 29.3 and 31 m; projecting triple-arch screen 22 m. Low courtyard galleries about 9 m, east gate 19.5 m. Minaret has an octagonal shaft, flared crown around 49 m, lantern to 53.2 m, pale cap to 56.2 m and finial top 57.4 m. Facade bays, gate widths, minor parapets and all vertical dimensions are estimates, not survey data. Fine calligraphy, lattice art, fixtures and unseen interiors are omitted.
reconstruction.scope: Individual medium-fi Baitul Mukarram National Mosque: cubic western prayer hall with three dark bands and triple-pointed-arch entrance, open paved east court, low pointed galleries, tall east through gate and southeastern octagonal minaret with flared lantern and small pale cap. Raw compound retained; internal partitions and all heights are picture estimates. Six existing shared 256² graphs and seven merged roles; four budgeted browser LODs. Fine art, furnished interiors and surrounding city omitted.
